description: Creates deterministic word-level diffs for document text on top of the shared Tempo.Blazor.Diff.TextDiff engine, and extracts readable plain text from a document snapshot or a single block. Above the engine's DefaultMaxTokens / DefaultMaxCells limits the comparison degrades to line level and DocumentTextDiffResult.IsDegraded says so.

members.name: Diff
members.description: Diffs old and new text at word/punctuation level and returns the ordered Unchanged/Removed/Added segments the document comparison renders.

members.name: ExtractBlockPlainText
members.description: Extracts readable plain text from a single document block.

members.name: ExtractPlainText
members.description: Extracts readable plain text from a document snapshot.
